entries.note: From the order status labels in the script of Pickupp's public tracking page (orderDisplayStatus.scheduled), which it shows in English. The order was created; 'pendingSchedule' shows the same text.
From the order status labels in the script of Pickupp's public tracking page (orderDisplayStatus.contactingAgent), which it shows in English. Pickupp is looking for a courier for the job.
From the order status labels in the script of Pickupp's public tracking page (orderDisplayStatus.accepted), which it shows in English. A courier accepted the job; the parcel is not collected yet.
From the order status labels in the script of Pickupp's public tracking page (orderDisplayStatus.arrivedPickup), which it shows in English. The courier reached the pick-up address.

From the order status labels in the script of Pickupp's public tracking page (orderDisplayStatus.enroute), which it shows in English. The courier has the parcel on the way to the drop-off address or the warehouse.
From the order status labels in the script of Pickupp's public tracking page (orderDisplayStatus.atWarehouse), which it shows in English. At a Pickupp warehouse.
From the order status labels in the script of Pickupp's public tracking page (orderDisplayStatus.arrivedDropoff), which it shows in English. The courier reached the drop-off address.
From the order status labels in the script of Pickupp's public tracking page (orderDisplayStatus.pendingSelfCollect), which it shows in English. Waiting for the recipient to collect it.
From the order status labels in the script of Pickupp's public tracking page (orderDisplayStatus.delivered), which it shows in English.
From the order status labels in the script of Pickupp's public tracking page (orderDisplayStatus.unableToDeliver), which it shows in English. The delivery attempt failed.
From the order status labels in the script of Pickupp's public tracking page (orderDisplayStatus.unableToPickup), which it shows in English. Collection from the sender failed.

From the order status labels in the script of Pickupp's public tracking page (orderDisplayStatus.backToWarehouse), which it shows in English. Going back to the warehouse after a failed delivery, not yet a return.
From the order status labels in the script of Pickupp's public tracking page (orderDisplayStatus.backToMerchant), which it shows in English. Being returned to the sender.
From the order status labels in the script of Pickupp's public tracking page (orderDisplayStatus.returned), which it shows in English. Returned to the sender.
From the order status labels in the script of Pickupp's public tracking page (orderDisplayStatus.cancelled), which it shows in English. Cancelled; the merchant-cancelled status shows the same text.
From the order status labels in the script of Pickupp's public tracking page (orderDisplayStatus.daCancelled), which it shows in English. The courier cancelled the job.
From the order status labels in the script of Pickupp's public tracking page (orderDisplayStatus.itemNotReceived), which it shows in English. The parcel never reached Pickupp.
From the order status labels in the script of Pickupp's public tracking page (orderDisplayStatus.expired), which it shows in English. The order expired without being fulfilled.
